_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The thinking indicator shows while a reply is awaited. "The reply R" is the first element matching '.messages-container [data-testid="message"]:not(.message-user)' whose text contains R (has_text): a message of this conversation that is not the user's. "The user message U" is the first '.messages-container .message-user' element whose text contains U (has_text). "The input" is the element with data-testid "message-input" and "the send button" the one with data-testid "send-button". "Send M" means: fill the input with M, then click the send button. "The indicator" is the element with data-testid "agent-thinking". 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Send "delay: 2". 3. The indicator should be visible (allow 5s). 4. The reply "Delayed for 2 seconds" should be visible (allow 30s). 5. The indicator should then be hidden (allow 10s).
